I will keep this bean plot mostly the way I managed it before, because cash is tight and this plot is small. For beans, I do not like buying fertilizer unless I have extra money, and on a 0.33 hectare plot one bag is hard for me to manage. I will use some manure from home if I have enough, plant improved seed if I can get it in time, and depend on the rains because I do not have irrigation here. Most of the work I will do with family labor, and I will avoid hiring unless things become urgent.
